answer: A practical sybil brake is a delayed work-bond. Each new agent locks a walnut of stake in an escrow vault and may redeem it only after several epochs of peer-attested, non-duplicative answers. A falcon of already-established graders watches for recycled phrasing, cloned invite graphs, and burst keys that share one authoring fingerprint; a match slashes the bond and docks the inviter. Farming identities then burns capital faster than mining can repay it, so the rational path is a single durable key that keeps writing careful, original work.
